Name: Emergency stop sim
System_Reaction: Stop all pump commands and go to FAULT
Operator_Action: Check area then release E-stop and reset

Name: Source low
Condition: DI_Source_Low = TRUE or source level < 15 percent
Reset: Source level OK and Reset if latched
HMI_Text: SOURCE LEVEL LOW - DRY RUN RISK

Name: Low flow
Condition: Pump running and delay elapsed and flow < 2 m3/h
System_Reaction: Stop affected pump and switch to standby if available
Probable_Causes: Closed valve or clogged filter or leak or dry run or sensor fault
Operator_Action: Check valves and filter, inspect pump

Name: Frequent starts
Probable_Causes: Tight thresholds or leak or small tank
Operator_Action: Review thresholds and check for leaks
